headline: Danish Economy Expands 0.8% in Third Quarter of 2026
summary: Denmark's gross domestic product grew by 0.8% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the previous quarter, according to Statistics Denmark. The growth beat economic expectations.
why: Gross domestic product measures the primary output of national economies, providing insights into regional economic trajectory in Northern Europe.
